I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random to confirm I've noted the correction: the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats. She said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else, and I didn't read or edit her #north-team post. My reply also said she can fix that post herself, or ask me to add a correction there.

Sharing the number in that channel was fine. A seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, and Ilse had already posted 100 seats there herself.
